exclusions.source_text: ECOG performance status ≤2 (Karnofsky ≥60%, see Appendix A).
Creatinine clearance ≥60 mL/min/1.73 m2 for participants with creatinine levels above institutional normal.
AST(SGOT)/ALT(SGPT) ≤2.5 × institutional upper limit of normal
Pregnant women are excluded from this study because AGuIX is contrast agent with the potential for teratogenic or abortifacient effects.
Known HIV-positive participants on combination antiretroviral therapy are ineligible because of the potential for pharmacokinetic interactions with AGuIX.
